title: Tahta Nyang Meujak Lam Siat .
intro: Sidroe tokoh otoritas nyang that rayeuk geumat peurintah ateuh saboh keurajeuen nyang kaya nyang geubri beureukat ngon keukayaan nyang hana teukira. Watèë na tantangan njang hana teudjadi, peunguasa njoë geuhadapi cobaan kon deungon peudeuëng tapi deungon hikmah dan iman. Peue nyang teudjadi akan meuakibatkan dari puncak kekuatan donya keu transformasi hate nyang mendalam.
clues: Ulôn mat peurintah ateueh saboh keurajeuen nyang geubri beureukat deungon keukayaan dan keumakmuran nyang hana hase teubayang .
Lon nakeuh sidroe raja nyang meukuasa nyang teurimong surat teuga nyang jituntut penyerahan .
Bangsawan-bangsawan ulôn geubri naseuhat keu ulôn peu kheueh harôh lôn prang atawa lôn meudamé ngon raja nyang jiôh nyoe .
Lon beurangkat ngon hadiah-hadiah nyang meugah keu lon meurumpok ngon raja nyang jioh nyoe keudroe .
Tahta keurajeuen ulôn ka jiba u nanggroe nyang jiôh lam sikleb mata, sigohlom ulôn woe .
Watèë ulôn tamong lam saboh meuligoë deungon lantai njang gleh lagèë kaca, akhédjih ulôn peugah keunong tundok keu Allah .

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
